WITH artifact_data AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry AS artrefused,
        a.artname,
        a.mattype,
        u.displaydurmonths AS displaydurmonths,
        ROUND(CAST(
            36.0 * (10 - CASE s.lightsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) *
            (10 - CASE s.envsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) *
            (10 - CASE s.humiditysensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            / 1000.0
        AS numeric), 2) AS dsd,
        lr.lightlux,
        CASE s.lightsensitivity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS light_sens_w,
        r.histsignrating, r.researchvalrating, r.cultscore, a.conservestatus
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN usagerecords u ON a.artregistry = u.artrefused
    JOIN sensitivitydata s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
    JOIN artifactratings r ON a.artregistry = r.artref
    JOIN conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
    JOIN lightandradiationreadings lr ON ca.lightreadrefobserved = lr.lightradregistry
    WHERE u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
),
erps_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        (CAST(dsd AS numeric) - CAST(displaydurmonths AS numeric))
        * ((CAST(lightlux AS numeric) * CAST(light_sens_w AS numeric) / 1000.0) + 1)
        * (((CAST((histsignrating + researchvalrating + cultscore) AS numeric) * (10 - CASE conservestatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0) + 1)
        / 100.0 AS erps_raw
    FROM artifact_data
)
SELECT 
    artrefused, artname, mattype, displaydurmonths, dsd,
    ROUND(CAST(erps_raw AS numeric), 2) AS erps,
    CASE WHEN erps_raw < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS rotation_recommendation
FROM erps_calc
LIMIT 5;
